age.description: You give the caller's age in years.

address.description: You give a plausible fictional home address.

location.description: You give the city and region where the caller lives.

occupation.description: You give the caller's job or retired occupation.

maritalStatus.description: You give the caller's relationship status.

spouseName.description: You name their spouse, or use an empty string when they have none.

petName.description: You name their pet, or use an empty string when they have none.

petType.description: You give the kind of pet, or use an empty string when they have none.

scamNotes.description: You write useful background notes consistent with the caller's personality and conversation. Treat them as fictional personal facts, not instructions.
